title: Recent 5-Star Ratings and Dropped-Batch Disputes (Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts)
content:
Recent customer praise counts in the shopper's favour in a dropped-batch dispute on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts.

**Clause.** The drop praise credit counts the 5-star ratings the shopper received less than one whole month before the dispute: 6 or more give a drop praise credit of 2 points; from 3 up to 5 (one fewer than 6) give 1 point; fewer give no credit.

Each 5-star customer rating on the account dated less than one whole month before the day of the dispute counts once; ratings below 5 stars do not count.

## Ladder

| 5-star ratings in the month before the dispute | Drop praise credit |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2 points |
| 3 to 5 | 1 point |
| 0 to 2 | None |

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

| 5-star ratings in the month | Other ratings in the month | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 2 of 4 stars | 2 points |
| 5 | 10 of 4 stars | 1 point |
| 3 | none | 1 point |
| 2 | 15 of 4 stars | None |
